correctness.rationale: The Cilleruelo-Granville Fibonacci four-tuples are exactly as stated. Fresh integer checks for n=2..30 reproduced the four distinct equal norms N_n and the n=2 points (15,10),(17,6),(18,1),(18,-1) on N=325. The inspected Laurent certificate proves the norm/distance identities for both parities as Laurent-polynomial identities, not by finite sampling. At x=0 phases align; averaging cos(2pi d.y) over the ball of radius 1/(2pi R) and using mean radius 2rho/3 gives the stated lower bound from max |d|/R<=sqrt(2/5)<0.633, hence M>=2.734. The chord identities imply the O(R^(1/3)) arc bound and M->4.
